english_paragraphs: The committee met on Tuesday morning to review the annual budget.
Several members raised concerns about the cost of the new library building.
After a long discussion, they agreed to postpone the final vote until next month.
Meanwhile, the city engineers will prepare a detailed estimate for each option.
The public will be invited to comment during an open meeting in the town hall.
Local businesses have already offered to sponsor the children's reading room.
Volunteers will collect donations at the farmers market every Saturday.
The chairman thanked everyone for their patience and closed the session.
A summary of the meeting will be published on the council website tomorrow.
Questions about the project can be sent to the planning office by email.
The architect presented three different designs for the main entrance.
Most residents preferred the version with large windows facing the river.
continuous: Rivers carry water from the mountains to the sea and shape the valleys they pass through over thousands of years while farmers along their banks depend on regular floods to bring fresh soil to their fields and fishermen follow the seasonal movement of the fish upstream and downstream depending on the temperature of the water and the amount of rain that has fallen in the hills during the previous weeks and in the cities that grew up beside the rivers merchants built warehouses along the docks where boats unloaded grain timber and cloth that had travelled for many days from distant markets so that the river became the main road of the whole region long before railways and highways were built across the plains and through the forests that once covered most of the land
